findings.explanation: RFC 8926 is "Geneve: Generic Network Virtualization Encapsulation". The VXLAN framework the title describes is RFC 7348.
findings.quote:
"title": "RFC 8926 — Virtual eXtensible Local Area Network (VXLAN): A Framework for Overlaying Virtualized Layer 2 Networks over Layer 3 Networks",
      "url": "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8926"
findings.suggested_fix: Cite RFC 7348 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7348) for VXLAN, and keep RFC 8926 only if Geneve overhead is discussed.

findings.explanation: Splunkbase 4241 is the "VMware NSX-T Splunk App", a VMware-built dashboard app, not a Splunk add-on. The same wrong name appears in dataSources, detailedImplementation and references.
findings.suggested_fix: Name it correctly, or drop it, since NSX overlay context is not used by the SPL.

findings.explanation: Splunkbase 1897 is "Cisco ACI Add-on for Splunk Enterprise (deprecated)", not "Splunk Add-on for Cisco ACI".
findings.suggested_fix: Use the catalogue name and flag it as deprecated, or point ACI context to Cisco DC Networking (7777).

findings.explanation: Interface MTU values, NVE error counters and probe results are not network sessions, so Network_Traffic does not fit. Nothing in the SPL produces Alerts-model records either. The schema rationale about aliasing ICMP frames into Network_Traffic is speculative.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop Network_Traffic and Alerts, or state that no CIM model applies, and keep Performance only if the counters are mapped there.

findings.explanation: It is unclear that `show ip mtu` is an NX-OS command. On Nexus, L3 MTU normally appears in `show interface` or `show ip interface`. The same command is repeated in the prerequisites and Step 3.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the Nexus 9000 show-command reference and replace the command with one that exists (e.g., `show interface | json` mtu field, `show ip interface`).

findings.explanation: The SPL computes `score` before `stats` but drops it at aggregation, so neither the visualization nor the alert can use it.
findings.suggested_fix: Either describe only the fields the SPL outputs, or note that score must be added to the stats clause.

findings.explanation: The reference points to Cisco's homepage, not the cited interfaces guide.
findings.quote:
"title": "Cisco Nexus 9000 Series NX-OS Interfaces Configuration Guide — Configuring Maximum Transmission Units",
      "url": "https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/"
findings.suggested_fix: Link the specific Nexus 9000 Interfaces Configuration Guide MTU section.

findings.explanation: The UC is marked verified, but the only reviewer is an automated agent and it contains a wrong RFC and wrong Splunkbase product names.
findings.suggested_fix: Downgrade status until an SME validates the UC.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `sum(df_drops)` per hour adds raw counter values. If the NVE/DF counters are cumulative (typical for interface counters), the sum grows with poll count rather than with new drops. A delta (streamstats/delta per device and interface) is needed before summing.

summary: The detailed implementation is concrete and largely consistent with the SPL. However, the core VXLAN reference cites the Geneve RFC, the add-on IDs and names are wrong (4241 and 1897), and Network_Traffic and Alerts do not fit MTU and counter telemetry.
